lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice brukar for everyday habits and routines.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Casual conversation about morning and evening routines.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about what they usually do in the morning, how they travel to work, and one quiet evening habit.

main_focus.name: brukar plus infinitive for habits
main_focus.description: Use brukar before an infinitive to describe repeated everyday actions.
model_examples: Erik brukar åka buss till jobbet.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use brukar plus infinitive naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: V2 word order after time expressions

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use routine words from morning to evening, but keep each turn short.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about the other's usual morning.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare one morning habit, one commute habit, and one evening habit.
dialogue_shape.ending: They react briefly and return to the workday.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat brukar in both statements and one question

focus: what one speaker usually does in the morning
how one speaker usually gets to work
what one speaker usually does in the evening

sentence_focus: one sentence with brukar about waking up
one sentence about going by bus
one sentence beginning with på kvällen
one sentence about a calm routine
